caveat: A witness that could not see says so. An absent report is not evidence that nothing happened. Outside event points are matched to the record in their 0.1° cell and the 8 around it, in the event month and the next one. MODIS burned area (MCD64A1) is a burn-scar product, but its mapping is guided by MODIS active fires, so it is not fully independent of the hotspot record.
